scope: Targeted primary-source research and proposed MVP only; no patient-memory implementation or efficacy claim.
method: Official framework/product documentation, a commit-pinned MIT source reference, and three research-paper abstract/metadata records. No blog/Reddit claims used.

sources.title: Memory overview
sources.read_scope: Conceptual sections on short/long-term memory, profiles, collections and writing strategies.
sources.supports: Separates thread state from cross-thread memory; structured profile/collection options; in-memory demonstration does not survive restarts.

sources.title: Persistence
sources.read_scope: Persistence overview, checkpointer/store comparison and restart caveat.
sources.supports: Checkpointer is thread-scoped; durable store is application/cross-thread data; RAM saver versus file-backed saver distinction.

sources.title: Stores
sources.read_scope: Namespace/key examples, runtime context, prefix search, bounded results and custom-store notes.
sources.supports: Namespaced memory, runtime identity, explicit pagination/ordering; namespacing is not authorization. Local installed BaseStore contract was inspected separately.

sources.title: Checkpointers
sources.supports: SQLite checkpoint package is suitable for local experimentation; checkpointing alone is not a patient profile/document store.

sources.title: LangGraph ReAct Memory Agent: README, graph, tools, context, package metadata and MIT license
sources.read_scope: Read all six archived files; did not install or execute the template.
sources.supports: Concrete MIT reference: retrieval by runtime user_id, model-facing memory tool with injected identity, upsert and recall across threads. Native tool binding/service assumptions require adaptation to the project's JSON dispatcher.

sources.title: How to Use Memory Tools; Memory Tools API Reference
sources.read_scope: Namespaced manage/search tools, schemas, persistent backend note and tool signatures.
sources.supports: Optional memory tooling and structured writes; example requires a persistent replacement for InMemoryStore. Not adopted or benchmarked.

sources.title: Python SDK Quickstart; Add Memory
sources.read_scope: SDK add/search examples, documented defaults, infer flag, user/session identifiers and managed/OSS distinction.
sources.supports: Reusable extraction/retrieval layer with identity filters. Documented default models/embedding/vector-store dependencies add components relative to the proposed local MVP; no performance claim adopted.

sources.title: Memory (Agent SDK)
sources.read_scope: Current memory setup, MemFS and background dreaming sections.
sources.supports: Current SDK uses versioned memory repository and optional background consolidation; distinguish this generation from legacy V1 block APIs.

sources.title: MemFS
sources.read_scope: Memory structure, search, versioning and local/cloud distinctions.
sources.supports: Small memory files in active context plus on-demand deeper files; git version history; no semantic/vector index by default. Framework architecture is a reference, not transplanted implementation.

sources.title: Memory blocks (core memory), V1 SDK legacy
sources.read_scope: Memory blocks and read-only-block section only.
sources.supports: Legacy example of structured in-context memory and immutable blocks; not described as the current MemFS API.

sources.title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
sources.publication_status: arXiv preprint version consulted; no independent venue verification.
sources.supports: Research basis for hierarchical memory and moving retained data into limited active context; no transferred performance claim.

sources.title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
sources.publication_status: arXiv version consulted; record lists ICLR 2025, not independently checked against proceedings.
sources.supports: Five evaluation abilities: extraction, multi-session reasoning, temporal reasoning, updates and abstention. Proposed project checks are inspired by these abilities, not official LongMemEval items.

sources.title: AMemGym: Interactive Memory Benchmarking for Assistants in Long-Horizon Conversations
sources.publication_status: arXiv preprint version consulted; abstract page states accepted to ICLR 2026, proceedings not independently verified.
sources.supports: Recent interactive evaluation using predefined structured state and evolving histories; informs a fixed synthetic script without adopting its LLM-user simulation.

sources.title: sqlite3 — DB-API 2.0 interface for SQLite databases
sources.read_scope: Database persistence overview, transactions and parameterized SQL guidance.
sources.supports: Small file-backed local store using Python's standard library; scoped parameterized reads/writes are application responsibilities.
